Dydra · documentation · manuals

Guides, read end to end.

Each manual takes one capability and follows it through from an empty repository to a working query, with the requests and responses written out.

01
manuals

One manual available

  • 01 Getting startedThis guides you along the shortest path from nothing to an answer: from an account, to a repository, then some statements in it, and eventually a query over them. It takes a few minutes. Everything here can be done in a browser or over HTTP, and both are shown, because most people start with the first and arrive at the second. 2026-09-03
  • 02 MCP & ScoreConnect a language model to a Dydra repository over the Model Context Protocol, and explore the graph in score — a compact notation for shaped queries. 2026-09-01
  • 03 RDF and SPARQLDydra stores RDF and answers SPARQL. Both are W3C standards, neither is ours, and that is the point: the data model and the query language are specified independently of any implementation, so what you write against Dydra you can read, move and re-run elsewhere. This manual is the short account of the two, for a reader who is about to use them rather than one studying them. 2026-09-03
  • 04 Dydra Studio User ManualThis manual provides comprehensive instructions for using Dydra Studio to manage your RDF data repositories, execute SPARQL queries, and administer your account on the Dydra platform. 2026-02-07
  • 05 Temporal Graphs & Collated RetrievalDydra can index the valid time your data carries and retrieve a whole entity in one pass. This chapter shows how to prepare a repository, declare the temporal property, shape and load a dataset, and write time-windowed collated queries — with a worked example end to end. 2026-08-23
  • 06 Working over HTTPDydra is an HTTP service and nothing else: there is no driver to install and no wire protocol to learn. Everything a program does – create a repository, load statements, run a query, read a past revision – is a request to a URL, made with whatever HTTP client the language already has. 2026-09-03
